display_duration.description: Seconds to display before rotating to next plugin (overridden by dynamic duration)

update_interval.description: How often to refresh market data from Kalshi API (seconds)

markets.description: Specific Kalshi market tickers to display (e.g. FEDFUNDS-26APR30-T5.00). Ignored when series_tickers or event_tickers is set.

series_tickers.description: Kalshi series tickers to pull all open events from (e.g. KXNFLDRAFTPICK). Takes precedence over markets/categories.

event_tickers.description: Specific Kalshi event tickers to display (e.g. KXNFLDRAFT1ST-26-1). Used with or in place of series_tickers.

categories.description: Market categories to fetch when no specific tickers/series/events are configured

max_markets.description: Maximum number of EVENTS to fetch (each event can render N tiles via outcomes_per_event)

outcomes_per_event.description: For multi-outcome events, render this many tiles per event (top N by probability). 1 = favorite only.

min_outcome_pct.description: When expanding to top-N outcomes, skip any outcome below this probability to avoid 0% filler tiles

min_volume.description: Only show events with at least this many contracts traded total

api_key.description: Kalshi API key (optional — public market data works without auth)

active_collection.description: ID of the collection under 'collections' to use as the ticker feed. Empty = fall back to top-level series_tickers/categories/markets.

collections.description: Named bundles of filters. Each value may contain display_name, series_tickers, event_tickers, categories, markets. Selected via /v3/remote dropdown.
